## SCIG / SCIGFun
**SCIGFun** is a web platform for pathway enrichment and functional interpretation using **cell-identity genes (CIGs)** generated by SCIG.

- GitHub: https://github.com/YOURUSERNAME/YOUR_REPO
- Zenodo DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14726426
- Docs / Demo: (add link)

### Features
- Upload gene expression matrices (bulk or scRNA-derived)
- Generate CIG-scored gene lists
- ORA/GSEA across multiple databases (GO, KEGG, Reactome, MSigDB, etc.)
- Interactive plots and downloadable results
